## quest create

Create a new quest

Aliases: `c`

```sh
woco quest create <id> <title> [flags]
```

Modifies project state. Supports `--dry-run`.

### Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Quest ID (kebab-case) |
| `title` | yes | Quest title |

### Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--goal` |  | string |  | Quest goal (required) **Required.** |
| `--priority` |  | string | `"medium"` | Priority level. Values: `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `wishlist`. |
| `--difficulty` |  | string | `"medium"` | Difficulty level. Values: `trivial`, `easy`, `medium`, `hard`, `very_hard`. |
| `--hitl` |  | string | `"yolo"` | HITL mode (yolo/cautious/supervised). Values: `yolo`, `cautious`, `supervised`. |
| `--agent` |  | string |  | Agent definition override for all tasks |
| `--dry-run` |  | boolean | `false` | Show what would happen without creating |
| `--force` |  | boolean |  | Force overwrite |

### Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
